channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: From Risky to Safe: Sadak Suraksha Abhiyan Makes India’s Roads Secure Nationwide
item.description: Every year, over 1.7 lakh lives are lost as India’s roads reflect gaps in awareness and behavior, highlighting the urgent need for responsible driving and prevention.

item.title: Global Backlash Forces Elon Musk’s Grok to Stop Generating Undressed Images of Real People on X
item.description: X has introduced new safeguards on Grok after global backlash over AI-generated sexualised deepfakes, amid rising regulatory scrutiny.

item.title: Two Teenage Girls Found Hanging at Sports Authority of India Hostel in Kerala’s Kollam District
item.description: Two minor athletes found hanging in SAI Kollam hostel; police launch probe into the unnatural deaths.

item.title: Iran Reopens Airspace After 5-Hour Blackout; Air India And IndiGo Issue Travel Advisories As Global Tensions Rise
item.description: Air India and IndiGo reroute flights as Iran shuts its airspace amid rising internal unrest and military fears.

item.title: Repeated Drone Sightings Along J&K Border Heighten Security Concerns and Renew India–Pakistan Tensions
item.description: Multiple suspected drones spotted across Jammu and Kashmir’s border sectors prompt heightened security responses and renewed calls for restraint.

item.title: From Festival Joy to Fatal Fall: Surat Family of Three Dies After 70-Foot Plunge From Flyover
item.description: A family celebrating Uttarayan in Surat lost all three members after their motorcycle crashed and plunged off a flyover, raising renewed safety concerns.

item.title: ‘Stay Vigilant’: India Issues High-Alert Advisory For Citizens In Israel; Urges Nationals to Avoid Non-Essential Travel
item.description: Indian Embassy in Israel issues urgent advisory to avoid non-essential travel amid rising Iran tensions and rocket exchange risks.

item.title: ‘Bird Droppings’: Danish Shuttler Mia Blichfeldt Flags Hygiene Concerns at India Open, Badminton Association Responds
item.description: Danish shuttler Mia Blichfeldt alleges bird droppings and dirt at India Open; BAI denies claims while BWF monitors safety.

item.title: Trump Rules Out Immediate US Strikes on Iran, Says Protest Killings Have Stopped, Options Remain
item.description: President Trump pauses military strikes on Iran, citing reports that the killing of protesters and executions have stopped.

item.title: Indian Coast Guard Intercepts Pakistani Fishing Boat After Illegal Incursion in Arabian Sea Near Gujarat
item.description: Indian Coast Guard intercepts Pakistani boat with 9 crew members after a high-speed chase in the Arabian Sea.
